prompt: Photograph of the interior of a small upscale clothing boutique at night: wall rails of hanging jackets, shirts and knitwear on both sides, folded sweaters on lit wooden shelves, a low display table, warm white LED strip lighting, no people, no mannequins in the centre, no readable text or logos. Realistic photography, warm highlights on near-black shadows. Shot wide, shallow depth of field, everything softly out of focus and darkened to a dim moody exposure so white text laid over it stays legible; the centre of the frame is the darkest, with a clear empty band across the middle where a product will float. Fills the whole frame edge to edge; no borders, no overlays, no UI. (Nano Banana 2.1 via Google Flow, 16:9, project 'Althologram - Clothing store'; Flow's 2K upscale, 2752x1536; top-cropped (offset 0) to 1344:585, scaled to 2688 wide, Gaussian blur 3 px. The user tried a lighter white-boutique plate and chose this darker one. The fan is rendered live in WebGL over this plate.) (WebP copy for the page, cwebp -q 82.)
